data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Rangeley Capital’s most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in STHO and FLL.

On September 23, 2026, six City Council agenda items in Asbury Park, NJ, mentioned the Waterfront Redevelopment Area, Block 3801, and 320 Asbury Avenue (entitlement). (https://asburyparknj.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=5735,plainText=false)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
